excluded_seeds.reason: ps3_8080 -- the part entered 8080 mode AT RUNTIME (a MEMW into the code region manufactured a `0F xx` pair after the compose-time scrub had run).  8080/BRKEM is DEFERRED BY USER DECISION 2026-08-05, so this capture is not a member of the scored population: it is out of every scored rate's numerator AND denominator and out of the replayed bank.  The capture is TRUE SILICON and is retained byte-identical; `--include-excluded` replays it.
